worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.summary: Lay a short-lived patch of quicksand on reachable aimed ground: fine sand cracks open as a warning, then the sand spreads and grit churns toward its centre. Only a grounded enemy whose feet stand on that surface is dragged in - slowing from light to a full hold over about 12 ticks, drawn toward the centre every beat and ground once every interval. Rising off the ground, stepping past the edge or losing the ground all break free at once; stepping back in sinks you again from the start. It can be pre-placed on empty ground, and fliers or airborne foes are unaffected. The deep style spreads longer and wider and pulls tighter each beat but grinds softer; the snare style grinds harder and ends sooner.
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.use.0: Turn a patch of ground into quicksand ahead of time to deny movement
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.use.1: Drag a heavy grounded target toward the centre
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.use.2: Wear down a bulky target with physical damage over time
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.use.3: Force a grounded foe to leap off the ground to break free
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.description.0: The quicksand is about %1$s blocks across and can open on reachable ground within %2$s blocks; the %3$s wind-up cracks the sand first, and a grounded target is held fully after about %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.description.1: A grounded target in the sand is ground every %2$s for about %1$s physical damage; each beat draws it %3$s blocks toward the centre; the sand lasts %4$s, and leaving the ground or the edge frees it at once.
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.option.on: Deep style on: duration x1.15, radius x1.2, pull x1.2, cooldown +8, but grind x0.9 - wider, longer quicksand that pulls tighter each beat but grinds softer.
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.option.off: Deep style off (snare): shorter duration, smaller radius, weaker pull and shorter cooldown, but full grind and it ends sooner. Both styles sink the target in at the same speed.
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.timing: Castable on reachable ground within %1$s blocks; after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; recover %3$s, cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.growth.0: At level %1$s the grind power rises to %2$s and the pull strength to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.preference.de: On: duration x1.15, radius x1.2, pull x1.2, cooldown +8, but grind x0.9 - wider, longer quicksand that pulls tighter each beat but grinds softer. Off: grinds harder, smaller radius and ends sooner. Both styles sink the target in at the same speed.
worldcombat.skill.sandtomb.preference.ai: Only consider quicksand on a threat within this distance; lower it to lay quicksand only up close, raise it to trap from farther away.

On: only lay quicksand under a grounded threat and skip airborne foes (no quicksand there, saving the cast); off: it will try on any threat in range, and an airborne foe is considered at lower priority and may be missed.
